cohort: 187 babies with NTD diagnoses at the Maternity and Child Teaching Hospital in Al-Qadissiyah Governorate, Iraq
finding: The incidence rate of NTDs was 9.4 per 1,000 births, with spina bifida (67.9%), encephalocele (24.02%), and anencephaly (8.02%) being the most prevalent defects.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the mode of delivery in 87.8% of cases.
